page.overview:
Who is Josuke Higashikata?

Josuke Higashikata is the Part 4 JoJo with Crazy Diamond, healing and reconstructing matter while protecting Morioh from Yoshikage Kira.

Also known as: Josuke, JoJo Part 4.
